folded.subject: And We
folded.object: not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims

spans.text: [36] AR: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ EN: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

folded.id: and we|left|therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment

spans.text: [37] AR: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ EN: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
[28] AR: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ EN: And he felt from them apprehension.
[40] AR: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ EN: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

folded.id: and|of|all things we created two mates
folded.subject: And
folded.object: all things We created two mates

spans.text: [49] AR: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
[45] AR: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ EN: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
[14] AR: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ EN: [And will be told], "Taste your torment.
[17] AR: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ EN: They used to sleep but little of the night,

folded.id: but|he|turned away with his supporters and said
folded.subject: But
folded.object: turned away with his supporters and said

spans.text: [39] AR: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ EN: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

folded.id: but|they|were insolent toward the command of their lord
folded.subject: But
folded.object: were insolent toward the command of their Lord

spans.text: [44] AR: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ EN: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
[10] AR: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ EN: Destroyed are the falsifiers
[53] AR: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ EN: Did they suggest it to them?
[48] AR: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ EN: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
[43] AR: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ EN: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
[54] AR: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ EN: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
[30] AR: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
[47] AR: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ EN: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

folded.id: it|is|truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking
folded.subject: it
folded.object: truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking

spans.text: [23] AR: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ EN: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

folded.id: it|left|nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins
folded.subject: It
folded.object: nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins

spans.text: [42] AR: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ EN: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
[45] AR: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ EN: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
[51] AR: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity.
[49] AR: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
[3] AR: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا EN: And those [ships] sailing with ease

folded.id: so we|brought|out whoever was in the cities of the believers
folded.subject: So We
folded.object: out whoever was in the cities of the believers

spans.text: [35] AR: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ EN: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

folded.id: so we|took|him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea
folded.subject: So We
folded.object: him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea

spans.text: [40] AR: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ EN: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
[14] AR: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ EN: [And will be told], "Taste your torment.

folded.id: the day|they|will be tormented over the fire
folded.subject: the Day
folded.object: will be tormented over the Fire

spans.text: [13] AR: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ EN: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

folded.id: the earth|are|signs for the certain [in faith]
folded.subject: the earth

spans.text: [20] AR: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ EN: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

folded.id: the heaven|is|your provision and whatever you are promised
folded.subject: the heaven
folded.object: your provision and whatever you are promised

spans.text: [22] AR: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ EN: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

folded.id: the hours|before|dawn they would ask forgiveness
folded.subject: the hours

spans.text: [18] AR: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ EN: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
[46] AR: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ EN: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

folded.id: the presence|of|your lord for the transgressors
folded.subject: the presence

spans.text: [34] AR: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ EN: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
[9] AR: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ EN: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
[6] AR: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ EN: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

folded.id: the right|of|the [needy] petitioner and the deprived
folded.subject: the right

spans.text: [19] AR: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ EN: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

folded.id: the righteous|will|be among gardens and springs
folded.subject: the righteous

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ EN: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

folded.id: the story|of|the honored guests of abraham?
folded.subject: the story

spans.text: [24] AR: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ EN: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?
[33] AR: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ EN: To send down upon them stones of clay,

[44] AR: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ EN: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
[31] AR: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ EN: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

folded.id: then|by|the lord of the heaven and earth
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: the Lord of the heaven and earth

spans.text: [23] AR: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ EN: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

folded.id: then|he|went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

spans.text: [26] AR: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ EN: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
Then will you not see?
Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

folded.id: this|is|that for which you were impatient
folded.subject: This
folded.object: that for which you were impatient

spans.text: This is that for which you were impatient."
[30] AR: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

folded.id: to those|before|them any messenger except that they said
folded.subject: to those
folded.object: them any messenger except that they said

spans.text: [52] AR: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ EN: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
[47] AR: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ EN: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
[25] AR: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ EN: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace."

folded.id: we|have|been sent to a people of criminals
folded.subject: we
folded.object: been sent to a people of criminals

spans.text: [32] AR: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ EN: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
[5] AR: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ EN: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

folded.id: when we|sent|against them the barren wind
folded.subject: when We

spans.text: [41] AR: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ EN: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

folded.id: when we|sent|him to pharaoh with clear authority
folded.subject: when We
folded.object: him to Pharaoh with clear authority

spans.text: [38] AR: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
[12] AR: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ EN: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
[25] AR: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ EN: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace."

folded.id: who|are|within a flood [of confusion] and heedless
folded.subject: Who
folded.object: within a flood [of confusion] and heedless

spans.text: [11] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ EN: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

folded.id: wife approached|with|a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said
folded.subject: wife approached
folded.object: a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said

spans.text: [29] AR: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ EN: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
[8] AR: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ EN: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
